title: Joy in Poetry a #potryport poem
summary: Joy in poetry found in brief pain and fascination watching verse bubble up a meniscus of blood seeping from freshly pulled scabs unsought answers gleam from miniscule curved surface of the monsters who make up our jagged souls #smallpoems #poetryport
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Joy in poetry
found
in brief
pain
and
fascination
watching verse
bubble up
a meniscus of blood
seeping from freshly
pulled scabs
unsought answers
gleam from miniscule
curved surface
of the monsters who
make up
our jagged souls
